E4Plus1.uk.description: The Young and the Restless: Uncle Phil's annoyed when Will sneaks out to a rap gig with Great Aunt Hattie. (S1 Ep18/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: It Had to Be You: Jazz asks Will to date his sister, Janet, who's just moved to town. But she turns out to be extremely bossy. (S1 Ep19/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Fabulous Faker Boy: Bart doesn't want to go to piano lessons, until he meets his beautiful teacher... Homer loses the last two hairs on his head. (S24 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Saga of Carl: Homer, Moe, Lenny and Carl win the lottery, but Carl runs off to Iceland with the winnings. (S24 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangers on a Train: While she's browsing for wedding anniversary cakes, Marge stumbles across a website for married people who want to have affairs. (S24 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brawl in the Family: The Simpsons have a fight when a game of Monopoly goes wrong, and Maggie has to call the police. (S13 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Flashy Little Flashdancer: Beverly takes up dancing. The kids are not impressed. Adam attempts to act cooler than Emmy's handsome new date. (S5 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Opportunity of a Lifetime: Barry gets the chance to throw the first pitch at a Phillies baseball game. Erica makes an important decision about her future. (S5 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Thunk in the Trunk: With Claire's business up and running, Phil's got a new role doing all the housework. But he feels invisible, ignored and under-appreciated... (S7 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Storm: When a huge thunderstorm knocks out the power, the whole family congregate at Jay and Gloria's to use their generator. But Jay wants to go to a Navy reunion. (S7 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: I Don't Know How She Does It: Claire has turned into super mum, running Jay's business and having time for all the duties at home. The kids are happy, but Phil is frustrated. (S7 Ep15)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Cover-Up: Phil has a new client who is also 'his type'. Afraid that might get him into trouble with Claire, he tells some seemingly innocent lies, which lead to more lies... (S7 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Blunder Years: A hypnotist reawakens repressed memories from Homer's childhood. But what was the event that scared him so badly when he was 12? Guest starring Paul Newman. (S13 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Parent Rap: Bart and Homer are tethered together by a strict judge after Bart and Milhouse are accused of stealing Chief Wiggum's police car. (S13 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homerland: When Homer returns from a nuclear power convention a changed man, Lisa suspects that he might have been brainwashed and hires an FBI agent to investigate. (S25 Ep1/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror XXIV: In three spine-tingling stories, Homer rhymes in a Dr Seuss-style tale, Bart is beheaded in a kite-flying prang, and a travelling circus visits town. (S25 Ep2/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Ste arranges to meet Imran. And Jack and Pearl plan their big day.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Panel: Ava and Gregory are invited to speak on a panel about public schools, while the other teachers complete CPR training. (S3 Ep8/14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Will Gets a Job: Will thinks that the Bel-Air lifestyle is making him lazy, and gets a job so that he can start paying his own way. (S2 Ep3/24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: PSAT Pstory: When Will outscores Carlton in an exam, Carlton is so desperate to prove his superiority that he gets caught cheating in a history test. (S2 Ep4/24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bob Mortimer, Richard Ayoade, Jennifer Saunders, Stephen Graham and Hannah Walters join the Goggleboxers for Survivor, Planet Earth III, Teen First Dates and loads more top TV. (S22 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's sharpest armchair critics watch: Banged Up: Stars Behind Bars, Planet Earth, Bake Off, Culprits, The Curse of Robert the Doll and much more. (S22 Ep10)
